components.name: Pattern workspace
components.description: Three-column drafting table: measurements left, drawing center, checking and printing right. Collapses to overlays on compact and phone.

components.name: Project panel
components.description: Collapsed local design panel with name, save, duplicate, undo, redo and export. JSON export lives in the toolbar.

components.name: Measure hero
components.description: Large active measurement figure (up to 140 px) with a slider, grouped measurements and client profiles.

components.name: Piece canvas
components.description: SVG drafting view with selectable pieces, zoom, pan, ruler and a visible line legend.

components.name: Seam inspector
components.description: Single list of seam edges with A/B badges, selected pair label and length comparison table.

components.name: Export panel
components.description: Paper, orientation, calibration and 1:1 PDF planning with assembly map.

narrative.overview: Working tool for an honest bespoke tailor or micro-atelier. The drawing carries the task; measurements and checking support it. The visual world is a variable-font specimen: paper, black ink, one red accent, hairline rules, Medeo Mono tabular numbers.
rules: Use semantic tokens, never hardcode colors
Preserve the user's work and validate imports
Keep source attribution for external designs
Show drafting errors even when panels are closed
dos: Keep contrast high in both themes
Make the active measurement immediately editable
Put primary actions in the toolbar
Use segments instead of dropdowns for small choices
donts: Do not add decorative illustration or gradients
Do not use more than one accent color
Do not hide the line legend on desktop
